How it works

From idea to estimate in minutes

No sales calls required to see the numbers. Answer a few questions and get a demo analysis instantly.

1. Describe your project

A new idea or an existing app that needs fixing — chat with the demo assistant or fill a short form.

2. Demo analysis runs

Our estimator identifies scope, required skills and effort using transparent example logic.

3. See team & cost

Get a recommended team with hours per role, hourly rates, total cost and delivery timeline.

4. Confirm on a call

An SCS consultant reviews everything with you and confirms the final scope and quote.

Two ways to start

Guided by AI, or hands-on manual

Both paths ask the same questions and produce the same analysis — switch anytime without losing answers.

AI Assistant flow

A friendly chat asks one question at a time with quick-reply chips, progress tracking and the option to edit any answer. Demo assistant — scripted, no live AI.

Start with AI

Manual form flow

A step-by-step form with validation, technology selectors, drag-and-drop references and automatic draft saving in your browser.

New Project

Fix Existing Project
